resumeText: I am a Junior QA Tester at Redrock Retail Systems, where I started as an intern and joined full-time. I write and execute manual test cases for our retail point-of-sale web app and log defects in Jira. I am learning test automation with Selenium and Playwright, recording and light-scripting browser flows, and I am currently teaching myself Python and API testing with Postman. I have not yet integrated automated tests into CI/CD, and my automation is still early-stage, but I am eager to grow into a professional SDET role.
